$comment: The structure of a twin definition, read by resources/js/twin/core/validate.ts (ajv) and app/Support/TwinDefinitionValidator.php (opis). x-message is what a failed check reports: {N:field} is a field of the Nth list item on the way to the problem, {value} the value found. Checks that need the rest of the definition (references, duplicates, expressions) stay in the validators. x-form tells the definition editor how to show a field.
